53    /**
54     * Taxpayer Identification Number (NIF in Portugal)
55     *
56     * @see http://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/N%C3%BAmero_de_identifica%C3%A7%C3%A3o_fiscal
57     *
58     * @return string 9 digit number
59     */
60    public static function taxpayerIdentificationNumber()
61    {
62        $firstEightDigits = static::numerify(static::randomElement(static::$firstEightDigitsFormat));
63        $lastDigit = static::dvCalcMod11($firstEightDigits);
64
65        return $firstEightDigits . $lastDigit;
66    }
67
68    /**
69     * Generate module
70     *
71     * @see http://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/D%C3%ADgito_verificador
72     *
73     * @param string $number number
74     *
75     * @return int
76     */
77    public static function dvCalcMod11($number)
78    {
79        $base = 9;
80        $sum = 0;
81        $factor = 2;
82
83        for ($i = strlen($number); $i > 0; --$i) {
84            $numbers[$i] = substr($number, $i - 1, 1);
85            $partial[$i] = $numbers[$i] * $factor;
86            $sum += $partial[$i];
87
88            if ($factor == $base) {
89                $factor = 1;
90            }
91            ++$factor;
92        }
93        $res = $sum % 11;
94
95        if ($res == 0 || $res == 1) {
96            $digit = 0;
97        } else {
98            $digit = 11 - $res;
99        }
100
101        return $digit;
102    }
